scripts.dev: npm run db:start && concurrently "npm run start-backend" "npm run start-frontend"
scripts.db:start: podman inspect jobsearch-mysql >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: Podman container jobsearch-mysql not found. See README -> Getting Started -> '2. Start MySQL' to create it.'; exit 1; }; podman start jobsearch-mysql >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo 'Waiting for MySQL to accept connections...'; for i in $(seq 1 30); do podman exec jobsearch-mysql mysqladmin ping --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo 'MySQL is ready.'; exit 0; }; sleep 1; done; echo 'ERROR: MySQL not ready after 30s. Check logs: npm run db:logs'; exit 1
scripts.test: npm run test-backend && npm run test-frontend
